label: Armor
description: Fantasy, historical and sci-fi armor for character design — tags couple with genre.

items.name: plate-full
items.text: a full plate harness, fluted engraved pauldrons, articulated lames at every joint, battle-worn edges catching the light

items.name: leather-scout
items.text: hardened leather scout armor, overlapping boiled-leather plates, buckled straps and a hooded half-cloak

items.name: chainmail-tabard
items.text: a riveted chainmail hauberk under a heraldic tabard, the quartered field bright against grey steel rings

items.name: samurai-oyoroi
items.text: lacquered samurai o-yoroi, kozane scale plates laced with silk cords, wide kusazuri skirts and a crested kabuto

items.name: power-armor
items.text: sleek powered exo-armor, segmented composite plating, glowing seam lines tracing the servo joints

items.name: scavenger-plate
items.text: improvised scavenger armor, stamped road-sign plates lashed with rope and wire over padded canvas

items.name: elven-filigree
items.text: elegant elven filigree armor, silver leaf-curved plates chased with vine patterns, an articulated weightless fit

items.name: gladiator
items.text: arena gladiator armor, one armored shoulder guard, bronze greaves and a wide studded belt over bare skin

items.name: brigandine
items.text: a brigandine of cloth-covered steel plates, rows of brass rivets across the chest, worn over mail sleeves

items.name: winged-hussar
items.text: winged hussar armor, gilt-edged breastplate over mail sleeves, a leopard pelt slung across one shoulder, a frame of eagle-feather wings rising from the back

items.name: hoplite-panoply
items.text: a Greek hoplite panoply, muscled bronze cuirass, crested Corinthian helmet pushed back on the head, bronze greaves and a heavy round aspis shield
